ValidationRule.description: Annual and Refreshment leave are locked during probation. Sick and statutory leave are deliberately NOT blocked - Thai law mandates paid sick leave regardless. Keep the types here in step with Locked_During_Probation__c on Leave_Type_Policy__mdt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Overtime_Request", OR( ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Annual leave"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Refresh Leave") ), NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:User.Probation_End_Date__c)), Term_From__c <= Owner:User.Probation_End_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Annual and Refreshment leave are not available during the probation period. Accrued leave becomes available once probation is complete.
